def verify_apple_caldav_account(
    *, account_email: str, app_specific_password: str
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Verify Apple iCloud CalDAV credentials and discover calendars.

    iCloud CalDAV discovery varies by account and region, so this method uses the
    standards-based principal/home-set flow and keeps the returned URLs opaque.
    """

    session = requests.Session()
    session.auth = (account_email, app_specific_password)
    session.headers.update({"Depth": "0"})

    principal_url = _discover_principal_url(session)
    calendar_home_url = _discover_calendar_home_url(session, principal_url)
    calendars = _discover_calendars(session, calendar_home_url)

    return {
        "account_label": account_email,
        "principal_url": principal_url,
        "calendar_home_url": calendar_home_url,
        "calendars": [calendar.__dict__ for calendar in calendars],
    }


def sync_apple_caldav_connection(
    connection_id: str, *, full_sync: bool = False
) -> dict[str, int]:
    from calendars.models import CalendarConnection

    connection = CalendarConnection.objects.select_related("user").get(
        id=connection_id,
        provider="APPLE_ICLOUD",
    )
    session = _authenticated_session(connection)
    totals = {"events_added": 0, "events_updated": 0, "events_deleted": 0}

    for connected_calendar in connection.calendars.filter(is_selected=True):
        calendar_result = _sync_apple_calendar(
            session,
            connected_calendar,
            full_sync=full_sync,
        )
        for key, value in calendar_result.items():
            totals[key] += value

    connection.status = "ACTIVE"
    connection.last_success_at = timezone.now()
    connection.last_error_code = ""
    connection.last_error_message = ""
    connection.save(
        update_fields=[
            "status",
            "last_success_at",
            "last_error_code",
            "last_error_message",
            "updated_at",
        ]
    )
    return totals


def export_event_to_apple_caldav(event: Any, connected_calendar: Any) -> dict[str, str]:
    from calendars.models import ExternalEventMirror

    if not connected_calendar.supports_write:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Selected Apple calendar is read-only.")
    if connected_calendar.connection.provider != "APPLE_ICLOUD":
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Calendar is not an Apple iCloud calendar.")

    session = _authenticated_session(connected_calendar.connection)
    mirror = ExternalEventMirror.objects.filter(
        connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
        local_event=event,
    ).first()
    href = (
        mirror.provider_event_id
        if mirror is not None
        else urljoin(connected_calendar.provider_calendar_id, f"{event.id}.ics")
    )
    ical_body = _event_to_ical(event)
    response = session.request(
        "PUT",
        href,
        data=ical_body,
        headers={"Content-Type": "text/calendar; charset=utf-8"},
        timeout=20,
    )
    if response.status_code not in {200, 201, 204}:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar rejected the event export.")

    ExternalEventMirror.objects.update_or_create(
        connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
        local_event=event,
        defaults={
            "provider_event_id": href,
            "i_cal_uid": str(event.id),
            "provider_etag": response.headers.get("ETag", ""),
            "status": "ACTIVE",
            "presentation_mode": "FULL_DETAILS",
            "share_policy_locked": False,
            "starts_at": event.start_time,
            "ends_at": event.end_time,
            "raw_payload": {"direction": "export"},
            "last_seen_at": timezone.now(),
        },
    )
    return {"href": href, "etag": response.headers.get("ETag", "")}


def _authenticated_session(connection: Any) -> requests.Session:
    session = requests.Session()
    session.auth = (connection.account_email, connection.app_specific_password)
    return session


def _sync_apple_calendar(
    session: Any, connected_calendar: Any, *, full_sync: bool
) -> dict[str, int]:
    if connected_calendar.sync_token and not full_sync:
        response = _sync_collection(session, connected_calendar)
        if response.status_code == 409:
            connected_calendar.sync_token = ""
            connected_calendar.save(update_fields=["sync_token", "updated_at"])
            response = _calendar_query(session, connected_calendar)
    else:
        response = _calendar_query(session, connected_calendar)

    if response.status_code in {401, 403}:
        connection = connected_calendar.connection
        connection.status = "REAUTH_REQUIRED"
        connection.last_error_code = "APPLE_REAUTH_REQUIRED"
        connection.last_error_message = "Apple Calendar credentials were rejected."
        connection.save(
            update_fields=[
                "status",
                "last_error_code",
                "last_error_message",
                "updated_at",
            ]
        )
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar credentials were rejected.")
    if response.status_code >= 400:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar sync failed.")

    return _apply_multistatus(connected_calendar, response.text)


def _sync_collection(session: requests.Session, connected_calendar: Any) -> Any:
    expansion_start, expansion_end = _recurrence_expansion_window()
    return session.request(
        "REPORT",
        connected_calendar.provider_calendar_id,
        headers={"Depth": "1"},
        data=f"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<d:sync-collection xmlns:d="{DAV_NS}">
  <d:sync-token>{connected_calendar.sync_token}</d:sync-token>
  <d:sync-level>1</d:sync-level>
  <d:prop>
    <d:getetag />
    <cal:calendar-data xmlns:cal="{CALDAV_NS}">
      <cal:expand start="{_caldav_timestamp(expansion_start)}" end="{_caldav_timestamp(expansion_end)}" />
    </cal:calendar-data>
  </d:prop>
</d:sync-collection>""",
        timeout=30,
    )


def _calendar_query(session: requests.Session, connected_calendar: Any) -> Any:
    expansion_start, expansion_end = _recurrence_expansion_window()
    return session.request(
        "REPORT",
        connected_calendar.provider_calendar_id,
        headers={"Depth": "1"},
        data=f"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<cal:calendar-query xmlns:d="{DAV_NS}" xmlns:cal="{CALDAV_NS}">
  <d:prop>
    <d:getetag />
    <cal:calendar-data>
      <cal:expand start="{_caldav_timestamp(expansion_start)}" end="{_caldav_timestamp(expansion_end)}" />
    </cal:calendar-data>
  </d:prop>
  <cal:filter>
    <cal:comp-filter name="VCALENDAR">
      <cal:comp-filter name="VEVENT" />
    </cal:comp-filter>
  </cal:filter>
</cal:calendar-query>""",
        timeout=30,
    )


def _apply_multistatus(
    connected_calendar: ConnectedCalendar, document: str
) -> dict[str, int]:
    from calendars.models import IMPORTED_EXTERNAL_EVENT_VISIBILITY, ExternalEventMirror
    from events.models import Event

    result = {"events_added": 0, "events_updated": 0, "events_deleted": 0}
    root = fromstring(document)
    sync_token = _xml_child_text(root, ".//{DAV:}sync-token")

    for dav_response in root.findall(".//{DAV:}response"):
        href = _absolute_icloud_url(_xml_child_text(dav_response, "{DAV:}href"))
        status_text = " ".join(
            node.text or "" for node in dav_response.findall(".//{DAV:}status")
        )
        if "404" in status_text or "410" in status_text:
            result["events_deleted"] += _tombstone_mirrors(
                ExternalEventMirror.objects.filter(
                    connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
                ).filter(
                    models.Q(provider_event_id=href)
                    | models.Q(provider_event_id__startswith=f"{href}#")
                )
            )
            continue

        calendar_data = _xml_child_text(
            dav_response, ".//{urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-data"
        )
        if not calendar_data:
            continue
        event_payloads = _parse_event_instances(calendar_data)
        if not event_payloads:
            continue

        mode = connected_calendar.import_mode
        if mode == "HIDDEN":
            continue

        seen_provider_ids = set()
        for event_payload in event_payloads:
            provider_event_id = f"{href}{event_payload['provider_occurrence_suffix']}"
            seen_provider_ids.add(provider_event_id)
            title = event_payload["title"] if mode == "FULL_DETAILS" else "Busy"
            location = event_payload["location"] if mode == "FULL_DETAILS" else ""
            description = event_payload["description"] if mode == "FULL_DETAILS" else ""
            visibility = (
                "PRIVATE"
                if mode == "FULL_DETAILS"
                else IMPORTED_EXTERNAL_EVENT_VISIBILITY
            )

            with transaction.atomic():
                event, created = Event.objects.update_or_create(
                    is_external=True,
                    external_source="APPLE_ICLOUD",
                    external_id=provider_event_id,
                    calendar_id=str(connected_calendar.id),
                    defaults={
                        "title": title,
                        "description": description,
                        "location": location,
                        "start_time": event_payload["start_time"],
                        "end_time": event_payload["end_time"],
                        "creator": connected_calendar.connection.user,
                        "family_group": _primary_family_for_user(
                            connected_calendar.connection.user
                        ),
                        "visibility": visibility,
                        "event_status": event_payload["event_status"],
                    },
                )
                ExternalEventMirror.objects.update_or_create(
                    connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
                    provider_event_id=provider_event_id,
                    defaults={
                        "local_event": event,
                        "i_cal_uid": event_payload["uid"],
                        "provider_etag": _xml_child_text(
                            dav_response, ".//{DAV:}getetag"
                        ),
                        "status": "ACTIVE",
                        "source_visibility_raw": event_payload["classification"],
                        "source_class_raw": event_payload["classification"],
                        "presentation_mode": mode,
                        "share_policy_locked": mode != "FULL_DETAILS",
                        "starts_at": event.start_time,
                        "ends_at": event.end_time,
                        "raw_payload": event_payload["raw_payload"],
                        "last_seen_at": timezone.now(),
                    },
                )
            result["events_added" if created else "events_updated"] += 1
        result["events_deleted"] += _tombstone_stale_occurrences(
            connected_calendar,
            href,
            seen_provider_ids,
        )

    if sync_token:
        connected_calendar.sync_token = sync_token
        connected_calendar.last_incremental_sync_at = timezone.now()
        connected_calendar.save(
            update_fields=[
                "sync_token",
                "last_incremental_sync_at",
                "updated_at",
            ]
        )
    return result


def _parse_event_instances(calendar_data: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    calendar = ICalendar.from_ical(calendar_data)
    components = list(calendar.walk("VEVENT"))
    overrides: dict[tuple[str, str], Any] = {}
    for component in components:
        recurrence_id = _component_recurrence_id(component)
        if recurrence_id is None:
            continue
        overrides[(str(component.get("UID") or ""), _occurrence_key(recurrence_id))] = (
            component
        )
    master_uids = {
        str(component.get("UID") or "")
        for component in components
        if component.get("RRULE") and not component.get("RECURRENCE-ID")
    }
    payloads: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for component in components:
        recurrence_id = _component_recurrence_id(component)
        if recurrence_id is not None:
            if str(component.get("UID") or "") not in master_uids:
                payloads.append(
                    _event_payload(
                        component,
                        recurrence_key=_occurrence_key(recurrence_id),
                    )
                )
            continue

        if component.get("RRULE"):
            payloads.extend(_expand_recurring_component(component, overrides))
        else:
            payloads.append(_event_payload(component, recurrence_key=""))

    return payloads


def _expand_recurring_component(
    component: Component, overrides: dict[tuple[str, str], Component]
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    window_start, window_end = _recurrence_expansion_window()
    start_time = _component_start(component)
    end_time = _component_end(component, start_time)
    duration = end_time - start_time
    rule_text = component.get("RRULE").to_ical().decode()
    rule = rrulestr(rule_text, dtstart=start_time)
    excluded_occurrences = _excluded_occurrence_keys(component)
    uid = str(component.get("UID") or "")
    payloads = []

    for occurrence_start in rule.between(window_start, window_end, inc=True):
        recurrence_key = _occurrence_key(occurrence_start)
        if recurrence_key in excluded_occurrences:
            continue
        override = overrides.get((uid, recurrence_key))
        if override is not None:
            payloads.append(_event_payload(override, recurrence_key=recurrence_key))
        else:
            payloads.append(
                _event_payload(
                    component,
                    start_time=occurrence_start,
                    end_time=occurrence_start + duration,
                    recurrence_key=recurrence_key,
                )
            )

    return payloads


def _event_payload(
    component: Any,
    *,
    start_time: datetime | None = None,
    end_time: datetime | None = None,
    recurrence_key: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    start_time = start_time or _component_start(component)
    end_time = end_time or _component_end(component, start_time)
    status = str(component.get("STATUS", "CONFIRMED")).upper()
    return {
        "uid": str(component.get("UID") or uuid4()),
        "title": str(component.get("SUMMARY") or "Busy"),
        "description": str(component.get("DESCRIPTION") or ""),
        "location": str(component.get("LOCATION") or ""),
        "start_time": start_time,
        "end_time": end_time,
        "event_status": "TENTATIVE" if status == "TENTATIVE" else "CONFIRMED",
        "classification": str(component.get("CLASS") or ""),
        "provider_occurrence_suffix": f"#{recurrence_key}" if recurrence_key else "",
        "raw_payload": {
            "summary": str(component.get("SUMMARY") or ""),
            "description": str(component.get("DESCRIPTION") or ""),
            "location": str(component.get("LOCATION") or ""),
            "status": status,
            "recurrence_id": recurrence_key,
        },
    }


def _component_start(component: Any) -> datetime:
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("DTSTART"))


def _component_end(component: Any, start_time: datetime) -> datetime:
    end_raw = component.get("DTEND")
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("DTEND")) if end_raw else start_time


def _component_recurrence_id(component: Any) -> datetime | None:
    if not component.get("RECURRENCE-ID"):
        return None
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("RECURRENCE-ID"))


def _excluded_occurrence_keys(component: Any) -> set[str]:
    exdate_values = component.get("EXDATE")
    if not exdate_values:
        return set()
    if not isinstance(exdate_values, list):
        exdate_values = [exdate_values]

    excluded = set()
    for exdate_value in exdate_values:
        for item in getattr(exdate_value, "dts", []):
            excluded.add(_occurrence_key(_to_datetime(item.dt)))
    return excluded


def _tombstone_stale_occurrences(
    connected_calendar: Any, href: str, seen_provider_ids: set[str]
) -> int:
    from calendars.models import ExternalEventMirror

    return _tombstone_mirrors(
        ExternalEventMirror.objects.filter(
            connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
            provider_event_id__startswith=f"{href}#",
            status="ACTIVE",
        ).exclude(provider_event_id__in=seen_provider_ids)
    )


def _tombstone_mirrors(mirrors_qs: Any) -> int:
    from events.models import Event

    event_ids = list(
        mirrors_qs.exclude(local_event__isnull=True).values_list(
            "local_event_id", flat=True
        )
    )
    now = timezone.now()
    updated_count: int = mirrors_qs.update(
        status="TOMBSTONED",
        tombstoned_at=now,
        local_event=None,
        updated_at=now,
    )
    if event_ids:
        Event.objects.filter(pk__in=event_ids, is_external=True).delete()
    return updated_count


def _to_datetime(value: datetime | date) -> datetime:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        parsed = value
    else:
        parsed = datetime.combine(value, time.min)
    if timezone.is_naive(parsed):
        return timezone.make_aware(parsed, datetime_timezone.utc)
    return parsed


def _recurrence_expansion_window() -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
    now = timezone.now()
    return (
        now - timedelta(days=RECURRENCE_EXPANSION_PAST_DAYS),
        now + timedelta(days=RECURRENCE_EXPANSION_FUTURE_DAYS),
    )


def _caldav_timestamp(value: datetime) -> str:
    return value.astimezone(datetime_timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


def _occurrence_key(value: datetime) -> str:
    return _caldav_timestamp(value)


def _event_to_ical(event: Any) -> str:
    calendar = ICalendar()
    calendar.add("prodid", "-//ClanCal//Calendar Sync//EN")
    calendar.add("version", "2.0")
    item = ICalendarEvent()
    item.add("uid", str(event.id))
    item.add("summary", event.title)
    item.add("description", event.description or "")
    item.add("location", event.location or "")
    item.add("dtstart", event.start_time)
    item.add("dtend", event.end_time)
    item.add(
        "status", "TENTATIVE" if event.event_status == "TENTATIVE" else "CONFIRMED"
    )
    calendar.add_component(item)
    return calendar.to_ical().decode()


def _primary_family_for_user(user: Any) -> Any:
    profile = getattr(user, "profile", None)
    if profile is not None and profile.primary_family_id:
        return profile.primary_family
    membership = user.family_memberships.first()
    return membership.family if membership is not None else None


def _discover_principal_url(session: requests.Session) -> str:
    response = session.request(
        "PROPFIND",
        "https://caldav.icloud.com/",
        data="""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<propfind xmlns="DAV:">
  <prop><current-user-principal /></prop>
</propfind>""",
        timeout=15,
    )
    if response.status_code in {401, 403}:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Invalid Apple Calendar credentials.")
    if response.status_code >= 400:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Unable to reach Apple Calendar.")

    href = _first_xml_text(response.text, ".//{DAV:}current-user-principal/{DAV:}href")
    if not href:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar principal was not discovered.")
    return _absolute_icloud_url(href)


def _discover_calendar_home_url(session: requests.Session, principal_url: str) -> str:
    response = session.request(
        "PROPFIND",
        principal_url,
        data="""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<propfind xmlns="DAV:" xmlns:cal="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav">
  <prop><cal:calendar-home-set /></prop>
</propfind>""",
        timeout=15,
    )
    if response.status_code >= 400:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar home set was not discovered.")

    href = _first_xml_text(
        response.text,
        ".//{urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-home-set/{DAV:}href",
    )
    if not href:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar home set was empty.")
    return _absolute_icloud_url(href)


def _discover_calendars(
    session: requests.Session, calendar_home_url: str
) -> list[CalDAVCalendar]:
    response = session.request(
        "PROPFIND",
        calendar_home_url,
        headers={"Depth": "1"},
        data="""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<propfind xmlns="DAV:" xmlns:cal="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav" xmlns:cs="http://calendarserver.org/ns/">
  <prop>
    <displayname />
    <getctag xmlns="http://calendarserver.org/ns/" />
    <sync-token />
    <resourcetype />
    <cal:calendar-color />
    <current-user-privilege-set />
  </prop>
</propfind>""",
        timeout=15,
    )
    if response.status_code >= 400:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple calendars could not be listed.")

    root = fromstring(response.text)
    calendars: list[CalDAVCalendar] = []
    for dav_response in root.findall(".//{DAV:}response"):
        href = _xml_child_text(dav_response, "{DAV:}href")
        if not href:
            continue
        resource_types = dav_response.findall(".//{DAV:}resourcetype/*")
        is_calendar = any(
            child.tag == "{urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar"
            for child in resource_types
        )
        if not is_calendar:
            continue

        privileges = {node.tag for node in dav_response.findall(".//{DAV:}privilege/*")}
        calendars.append(
            CalDAVCalendar(
                provider_calendar_id=_absolute_icloud_url(href),
                title=_xml_child_text(dav_response, ".//{DAV:}displayname")
                or "Apple Calendar",
                color=_xml_child_text(
                    dav_response,
                    ".//{http://apple.com/ns/ical/}calendar-color",
                )
                or "",
                access_role="owner" if "{DAV:}write" in privileges else "reader",
                supports_write="{DAV:}write" in privileges,
                sync_token=_xml_child_text(dav_response, ".//{DAV:}sync-token") or "",
                etag=_xml_child_text(
                    dav_response, ".//{http://calendarserver.org/ns/}getctag"
                )
                or "",
            )
        )
    return calendars


def _first_xml_text(document: str, path: str) -> str:
    root = fromstring(document)
    node = root.find(path)
    return (node.text or "").strip() if node is not None else ""


def _xml_child_text(node: Any, path: str) -> str:
    child = node.find(path)
    return (child.text or "").strip() if child is not None else ""


def _absolute_icloud_url(href: str) -> str:
    if href.startswith("http://") or href.startswith("https://"):

                    is_external=True,
                    external_source="APPLE_ICLOUD",
                    external_id=provider_event_id,
                    calendar_id=str(connected_calendar.id),
                    defaults={
                        "title": title,
                        "description": description,
                        "location": location,
                        "start_time": event_payload["start_time"],
                        "end_time": event_payload["end_time"],
                        "creator": connected_calendar.connection.user,
                        "family_group": _primary_family_for_user(

                        "visibility": visibility,
                        "event_status": event_payload["event_status"],

                "last_incremental_sync_at",

def _parse_event_instances(calendar_data: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    calendar = ICalendar.from_ical(calendar_data)
    components = list(calendar.walk("VEVENT"))
    overrides: dict[tuple[str, str], Any] = {}
    for component in components:
        recurrence_id = _component_recurrence_id(component)
        if recurrence_id is None:
            continue
        overrides[(str(component.get("UID") or ""), _occurrence_key(recurrence_id))] = (
            component
        )
    master_uids = {
        str(component.get("UID") or "")
        for component in components
        if component.get("RRULE") and not component.get("RECURRENCE-ID")
    }
    payloads: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for component in components:
        recurrence_id = _component_recurrence_id(component)
        if recurrence_id is not None:
            if str(component.get("UID") or "") not in master_uids:
                payloads.append(
                    _event_payload(
                        component,
                        recurrence_key=_occurrence_key(recurrence_id),
                    )
                )
            continue

        if component.get("RRULE"):
            payloads.extend(_expand_recurring_component(component, overrides))
        else:
            payloads.append(_event_payload(component, recurrence_key=""))

    return payloads


def _expand_recurring_component(
    component: Component, overrides: dict[tuple[str, str], Component]
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    window_start, window_end = _recurrence_expansion_window()
    start_time = _component_start(component)
    end_time = _component_end(component, start_time)
    duration = end_time - start_time
    rule_text = component.get("RRULE").to_ical().decode()
    rule = rrulestr(rule_text, dtstart=start_time)
    excluded_occurrences = _excluded_occurrence_keys(component)
    uid = str(component.get("UID") or "")
    payloads = []

    for occurrence_start in rule.between(window_start, window_end, inc=True):
        recurrence_key = _occurrence_key(occurrence_start)
        if recurrence_key in excluded_occurrences:
            continue
        override = overrides.get((uid, recurrence_key))
        if override is not None:
            payloads.append(_event_payload(override, recurrence_key=recurrence_key))
        else:
            payloads.append(
                _event_payload(
                    component,
                    start_time=occurrence_start,
                    end_time=occurrence_start + duration,
                    recurrence_key=recurrence_key,
                )
            )

    return payloads


def _event_payload(
    component: Any,
    *,
    start_time: datetime | None = None,
    end_time: datetime | None = None,
    recurrence_key: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    start_time = start_time or _component_start(component)
    end_time = end_time or _component_end(component, start_time)
    status = str(component.get("STATUS", "CONFIRMED")).upper()
    return {
        "uid": str(component.get("UID") or uuid4()),
        "title": str(component.get("SUMMARY") or "Busy"),
        "description": str(component.get("DESCRIPTION") or ""),
        "location": str(component.get("LOCATION") or ""),
        "start_time": start_time,
        "end_time": end_time,
        "event_status": "TENTATIVE" if status == "TENTATIVE" else "CONFIRMED",
        "classification": str(component.get("CLASS") or ""),
        "provider_occurrence_suffix": f"#{recurrence_key}" if recurrence_key else "",
        "raw_payload": {
            "summary": str(component.get("SUMMARY") or ""),
            "description": str(component.get("DESCRIPTION") or ""),
            "location": str(component.get("LOCATION") or ""),
            "status": status,
            "recurrence_id": recurrence_key,
        },
    }


def _component_start(component: Any) -> datetime:
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("DTSTART"))


def _component_end(component: Any, start_time: datetime) -> datetime:
    end_raw = component.get("DTEND")
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("DTEND")) if end_raw else start_time


def _component_recurrence_id(component: Any) -> datetime | None:
    if not component.get("RECURRENCE-ID"):
        return None
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("RECURRENCE-ID"))


def _excluded_occurrence_keys(component: Any) -> set[str]:
    exdate_values = component.get("EXDATE")
    if not exdate_values:
        return set()
    if not isinstance(exdate_values, list):
        exdate_values = [exdate_values]

    excluded = set()
    for exdate_value in exdate_values:
        for item in getattr(exdate_value, "dts", []):
            excluded.add(_occurrence_key(_to_datetime(item.dt)))
    return excluded


def _tombstone_stale_occurrences(
    connected_calendar: Any, href: str, seen_provider_ids: set[str]
) -> int:
    from calendars.models import ExternalEventMirror

    return _tombstone_mirrors(
        ExternalEventMirror.objects.filter(
            connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
            provider_event_id__startswith=f"{href}#",
            status="ACTIVE",
        ).exclude(provider_event_id__in=seen_provider_ids)
    )


def _tombstone_mirrors(mirrors_qs: Any) -> int:
    from events.models import Event

    event_ids = list(
        mirrors_qs.exclude(local_event__isnull=True).values_list(
            "local_event_id", flat=True
        )
    )
    now = timezone.now()
    updated_count: int = mirrors_qs.update(
        status="TOMBSTONED",
        tombstoned_at=now,
        local_event=None,
        updated_at=now,
    )
    if event_ids:
        Event.objects.filter(pk__in=event_ids, is_external=True).delete()
    return updated_count


def _to_datetime(value: datetime | date) -> datetime:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        parsed = value
    else:
        parsed = datetime.combine(value, time.min)
    if timezone.is_naive(parsed):
        return timezone.make_aware(parsed, datetime_timezone.utc)
    return parsed


def _recurrence_expansion_window() -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
    now = timezone.now()
    return (
        now - timedelta(days=RECURRENCE_EXPANSION_PAST_DAYS),
        now + timedelta(days=RECURRENCE_EXPANSION_FUTURE_DAYS),
    )


def _caldav_timestamp(value: datetime) -> str:
    return value.astimezone(datetime_timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


def _occurrence_key(value: datetime) -> str:
    return _caldav_timestamp(value)


def _event_to_ical(event: Any) -> str:
    calendar = ICalendar()
    calendar.add("prodid", "-//ClanCal//Calendar Sync//EN")
    calendar.add("version", "2.0")
    item = ICalendarEvent()
    item.add("uid", str(event.id))
    item.add("summary", event.title)
    item.add("description", event.description or "")
    item.add("location", event.location or "")
    item.add("dtstart", event.start_time)
    item.add("dtend", event.end_time)
    item.add(
        "status", "TENTATIVE" if event.event_status == "TENTATIVE" else "CONFIRMED"
    )
    calendar.add_component(item)
    return calendar.to_ical().decode()


def _primary_family_for_user(user: Any) -> Any:
    profile = getattr(user, "profile", None)
    if profile is not None and profile.primary_family_id:
        return profile.primary_family
    membership = user.family_memberships.first()
    return membership.family if membership is not None else None


def _discover_principal_url(session: requests.Session) -> str:
    response = session.request(
        "PROPFIND",
        "https://caldav.icloud.com/",
        data="""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<propfind xmlns="DAV:">
  <prop><current-user-principal /></prop>
</propfind>""",
        timeout=15,
    )
    if response.status_code in {401, 403}:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Invalid Apple Calendar credentials.")
    if response.status_code >= 400:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Unable to reach Apple Calendar.")

    href = _first_xml_text(response.text, ".//{DAV:}current-user-principal/{DAV:}href")
    if not href:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar principal was not discovered.")
    return _absolute_icloud_url(href)


def _discover_calendar_home_url(session: requests.Session, principal_url: str) -> str:
    response = session.request(
        "PROPFIND",
        principal_url,
        data="""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<propfind xmlns="DAV:" xmlns:cal="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav">
  <prop><cal:calendar-home-set /></prop>
</propfind>""",
        timeout=15,
    )
    if response.status_code >= 400:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar home set was not discovered.")

    href = _first_xml_text(
        response.text,
        ".//{urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-home-set/{DAV:}href",
    )
    if not href:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar home set was empty.")
    return _absolute_icloud_url(href)

    session: requests.Session, calendar_home_url: str
) -> list[CalDAVCalendar]:
    response = session.request(
        "PROPFIND",
        calendar_home_url,

    from calendars.models import ExternalEventMirror

    if not connected_calendar.supports_write:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Selected Apple calendar is read-only.")
    if connected_calendar.connection.provider != "APPLE_ICLOUD":
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Calendar is not an Apple iCloud calendar.")

    session = _authenticated_session(connected_calendar.connection)
    mirror = ExternalEventMirror.objects.filter(
        connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
        local_event=event,
    ).first()
    href = (
        mirror.provider_event_id
        if mirror is not None
        else urljoin(connected_calendar.provider_calendar_id, f"{event.id}.ics")

    response = session.request(
        "PUT",
        href,
        data=ical_body,
        headers={"Content-Type": "text/calendar; charset=utf-8"},
        timeout=20,
    )
    if response.status_code not in {200, 201, 204}:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar rejected the event export.")

    ExternalEventMirror.objects.update_or_create(
        connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
        local_event=event,
        defaults={

            "provider_etag": response.headers.get("ETag", ""),

            "ends_at": event.end_time,

def _parse_event_instances(calendar_data: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    calendar = ICalendar.from_ical(calendar_data)
    components = list(calendar.walk("VEVENT"))
    overrides: dict[tuple[str, str], Any] = {}
    for component in components:
        recurrence_id = _component_recurrence_id(component)
        if recurrence_id is None:
            continue
        overrides[(str(component.get("UID") or ""), _occurrence_key(recurrence_id))] = (
            component
        )
    master_uids = {
        str(component.get("UID") or "")
        for component in components
        if component.get("RRULE") and not component.get("RECURRENCE-ID")
    }
    payloads: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for component in components:
        recurrence_id = _component_recurrence_id(component)
        if recurrence_id is not None:
            if str(component.get("UID") or "") not in master_uids:
                payloads.append(
                    _event_payload(
                        component,
                        recurrence_key=_occurrence_key(recurrence_id),
                    )
                )
            continue

        if component.get("RRULE"):
            payloads.extend(_expand_recurring_component(component, overrides))
        else:
            payloads.append(_event_payload(component, recurrence_key=""))

    return payloads


def _expand_recurring_component(
    component: Component, overrides: dict[tuple[str, str], Component]
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    window_start, window_end = _recurrence_expansion_window()
    start_time = _component_start(component)
    end_time = _component_end(component, start_time)
    duration = end_time - start_time
    rule_text = component.get("RRULE").to_ical().decode()
    rule = rrulestr(rule_text, dtstart=start_time)
    excluded_occurrences = _excluded_occurrence_keys(component)
    uid = str(component.get("UID") or "")
    payloads = []

    for occurrence_start in rule.between(window_start, window_end, inc=True):
        recurrence_key = _occurrence_key(occurrence_start)
        if recurrence_key in excluded_occurrences:
            continue
        override = overrides.get((uid, recurrence_key))
        if override is not None:
            payloads.append(_event_payload(override, recurrence_key=recurrence_key))
        else:
            payloads.append(
                _event_payload(
                    component,
                    start_time=occurrence_start,
                    end_time=occurrence_start + duration,
                    recurrence_key=recurrence_key,
                )
            )

    return payloads


def _event_payload(
    component: Any,
    *,
    start_time: datetime | None = None,
    end_time: datetime | None = None,
    recurrence_key: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    start_time = start_time or _component_start(component)
    end_time = end_time or _component_end(component, start_time)
    status = str(component.get("STATUS", "CONFIRMED")).upper()
    return {
        "uid": str(component.get("UID") or uuid4()),
        "title": str(component.get("SUMMARY") or "Busy"),
        "description": str(component.get("DESCRIPTION") or ""),
        "location": str(component.get("LOCATION") or ""),
        "start_time": start_time,
        "end_time": end_time,
        "event_status": "TENTATIVE" if status == "TENTATIVE" else "CONFIRMED",
        "classification": str(component.get("CLASS") or ""),
        "provider_occurrence_suffix": f"#{recurrence_key}" if recurrence_key else "",
        "raw_payload": {
            "summary": str(component.get("SUMMARY") or ""),
            "description": str(component.get("DESCRIPTION") or ""),
            "location": str(component.get("LOCATION") or ""),
            "status": status,
            "recurrence_id": recurrence_key,
        },
    }


def _component_start(component: Any) -> datetime:
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("DTSTART"))


def _component_end(component: Any, start_time: datetime) -> datetime:
    end_raw = component.get("DTEND")
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("DTEND")) if end_raw else start_time


def _component_recurrence_id(component: Any) -> datetime | None:
    if not component.get("RECURRENCE-ID"):
        return None
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("RECURRENCE-ID"))


def _excluded_occurrence_keys(component: Any) -> set[str]:
    exdate_values = component.get("EXDATE")
    if not exdate_values:
        return set()
    if not isinstance(exdate_values, list):
        exdate_values = [exdate_values]

    excluded = set()
    for exdate_value in exdate_values:
        for item in getattr(exdate_value, "dts", []):
            excluded.add(_occurrence_key(_to_datetime(item.dt)))
    return excluded


def _tombstone_stale_occurrences(
    connected_calendar: Any, href: str, seen_provider_ids: set[str]
) -> int:
    from calendars.models import ExternalEventMirror

    return _tombstone_mirrors(
        ExternalEventMirror.objects.filter(
            connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
            provider_event_id__startswith=f"{href}#",
            status="ACTIVE",
        ).exclude(provider_event_id__in=seen_provider_ids)
    )


def _tombstone_mirrors(mirrors_qs: Any) -> int:
    from events.models import Event

    event_ids = list(
        mirrors_qs.exclude(local_event__isnull=True).values_list(
            "local_event_id", flat=True
        )
    )
    now = timezone.now()
    updated_count: int = mirrors_qs.update(
        status="TOMBSTONED",
        tombstoned_at=now,
        local_event=None,
        updated_at=now,
    )
    if event_ids:
        Event.objects.filter(pk__in=event_ids, is_external=True).delete()
    return updated_count


def _to_datetime(value: datetime | date) -> datetime:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        parsed = value
    else:
        parsed = datetime.combine(value, time.min)
    if timezone.is_naive(parsed):
        return timezone.make_aware(parsed, datetime_timezone.utc)
    return parsed


def _recurrence_expansion_window() -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
    now = timezone.now()
    return (
        now - timedelta(days=RECURRENCE_EXPANSION_PAST_DAYS),
        now + timedelta(days=RECURRENCE_EXPANSION_FUTURE_DAYS),
    )


def _caldav_timestamp(value: datetime) -> str:
    return value.astimezone(datetime_timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


def _occurrence_key(value: datetime) -> str:
    return _caldav_timestamp(value)


def _event_to_ical(event: Any) -> str:
    calendar = ICalendar()
    calendar.add("prodid", "-//ClanCal//Calendar Sync//EN")
    calendar.add("version", "2.0")
    item = ICalendarEvent()
    item.add("uid", str(event.id))
    item.add("summary", event.title)
    item.add("description", event.description or "")
    item.add("location", event.location or "")
    item.add("dtstart", event.start_time)
    item.add("dtend", event.end_time)
    item.add(
        "status", "TENTATIVE" if event.event_status == "TENTATIVE" else "CONFIRMED"
    )
    calendar.add_component(item)
    return calendar.to_ical().decode()


def _primary_family_for_user(user: Any) -> Any:
    profile = getattr(user, "profile", None)
    if profile is not None and profile.primary_family_id:
        return profile.primary_family
    membership = user.family_memberships.first()
    return membership.family if membership is not None else None

def _parse_event_instances(calendar_data: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    calendar = ICalendar.from_ical(calendar_data)
    components = list(calendar.walk("VEVENT"))
    overrides: dict[tuple[str, str], Any] = {}
    for component in components:
        recurrence_id = _component_recurrence_id(component)
        if recurrence_id is None:
            continue
        overrides[(str(component.get("UID") or ""), _occurrence_key(recurrence_id))] = (
            component
        )
    master_uids = {
        str(component.get("UID") or "")
        for component in components
        if component.get("RRULE") and not component.get("RECURRENCE-ID")
    }
    payloads: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for component in components:
        recurrence_id = _component_recurrence_id(component)
        if recurrence_id is not None:
            if str(component.get("UID") or "") not in master_uids:
                payloads.append(
                    _event_payload(
                        component,
                        recurrence_key=_occurrence_key(recurrence_id),
                    )
                )
            continue

        if component.get("RRULE"):
            payloads.extend(_expand_recurring_component(component, overrides))
        else:
            payloads.append(_event_payload(component, recurrence_key=""))

    return payloads


def _expand_recurring_component(
    component: Component, overrides: dict[tuple[str, str], Component]
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    window_start, window_end = _recurrence_expansion_window()
    start_time = _component_start(component)
    end_time = _component_end(component, start_time)
    duration = end_time - start_time
    rule_text = component.get("RRULE").to_ical().decode()
    rule = rrulestr(rule_text, dtstart=start_time)
    excluded_occurrences = _excluded_occurrence_keys(component)
    uid = str(component.get("UID") or "")
    payloads = []

    for occurrence_start in rule.between(window_start, window_end, inc=True):
        recurrence_key = _occurrence_key(occurrence_start)
        if recurrence_key in excluded_occurrences:
            continue
        override = overrides.get((uid, recurrence_key))
        if override is not None:
            payloads.append(_event_payload(override, recurrence_key=recurrence_key))
        else:
            payloads.append(
                _event_payload(
                    component,
                    start_time=occurrence_start,
                    end_time=occurrence_start + duration,
                    recurrence_key=recurrence_key,
                )
            )

    return payloads


def _event_payload(
    component: Any,
    *,
    start_time: datetime | None = None,
    end_time: datetime | None = None,
    recurrence_key: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    start_time = start_time or _component_start(component)
    end_time = end_time or _component_end(component, start_time)
    status = str(component.get("STATUS", "CONFIRMED")).upper()
    return {
        "uid": str(component.get("UID") or uuid4()),
        "title": str(component.get("SUMMARY") or "Busy"),
        "description": str(component.get("DESCRIPTION") or ""),
        "location": str(component.get("LOCATION") or ""),
        "start_time": start_time,
        "end_time": end_time,
        "event_status": "TENTATIVE" if status == "TENTATIVE" else "CONFIRMED",
        "classification": str(component.get("CLASS") or ""),
        "provider_occurrence_suffix": f"#{recurrence_key}" if recurrence_key else "",
        "raw_payload": {
            "summary": str(component.get("SUMMARY") or ""),
            "description": str(component.get("DESCRIPTION") or ""),
            "location": str(component.get("LOCATION") or ""),
            "status": status,
            "recurrence_id": recurrence_key,
        },
    }

    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("DTSTART"))


def _component_end(component: Any, start_time: datetime) -> datetime:
    end_raw = component.get("DTEND")
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("DTEND")) if end_raw else start_time


def _component_recurrence_id(component: Any) -> datetime | None:
    if not component.get("RECURRENCE-ID"):
        return None
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("RECURRENCE-ID"))


def _excluded_occurrence_keys(component: Any) -> set[str]:
    exdate_values = component.get("EXDATE")
    if not exdate_values:
        return set()
    if not isinstance(exdate_values, list):
        exdate_values = [exdate_values]

    excluded = set()
    for exdate_value in exdate_values:
        for item in getattr(exdate_value, "dts", []):
            excluded.add(_occurrence_key(_to_datetime(item.dt)))
    return excluded

            if str(component.get("UID") or "") not in master_uids:
                payloads.append(
                    _event_payload(
                        component,
                        recurrence_key=_occurrence_key(recurrence_id),
                    )
                )
            continue

        if component.get("RRULE"):
            payloads.extend(_expand_recurring_component(component, overrides))
        else:
            payloads.append(_event_payload(component, recurrence_key=""))

    return payloads


def _expand_recurring_component(
    component: Component, overrides: dict[tuple[str, str], Component]
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    window_start, window_end = _recurrence_expansion_window()
    start_time = _component_start(component)
    end_time = _component_end(component, start_time)
    duration = end_time - start_time
    rule_text = component.get("RRULE").to_ical().decode()
    rule = rrulestr(rule_text, dtstart=start_time)
    excluded_occurrences = _excluded_occurrence_keys(component)
    uid = str(component.get("UID") or "")
    payloads = []

    for occurrence_start in rule.between(window_start, window_end, inc=True):
        recurrence_key = _occurrence_key(occurrence_start)
        if recurrence_key in excluded_occurrences:
            continue
        override = overrides.get((uid, recurrence_key))
        if override is not None:
            payloads.append(_event_payload(override, recurrence_key=recurrence_key))
        else:
            payloads.append(
                _event_payload(
                    component,
                    start_time=occurrence_start,
                    end_time=occurrence_start + duration,
                    recurrence_key=recurrence_key,
                )
            )

    return payloads


def _event_payload(
    component: Any,
    *,
    start_time: datetime | None = None,
    end_time: datetime | None = None,
    recurrence_key: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    start_time = start_time or _component_start(component)
    end_time = end_time or _component_end(component, start_time)
    status = str(component.get("STATUS", "CONFIRMED")).upper()
    return {
        "uid": str(component.get("UID") or uuid4()),
        "title": str(component.get("SUMMARY") or "Busy"),
        "description": str(component.get("DESCRIPTION") or ""),
        "location": str(component.get("LOCATION") or ""),
        "start_time": start_time,
        "end_time": end_time,
        "event_status": "TENTATIVE" if status == "TENTATIVE" else "CONFIRMED",
        "classification": str(component.get("CLASS") or ""),
        "provider_occurrence_suffix": f"#{recurrence_key}" if recurrence_key else "",
        "raw_payload": {
            "summary": str(component.get("SUMMARY") or ""),
            "description": str(component.get("DESCRIPTION") or ""),
            "location": str(component.get("LOCATION") or ""),
            "status": status,
            "recurrence_id": recurrence_key,
        },
    }


def _component_start(component: Any) -> datetime:
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("DTSTART"))


def _component_end(component: Any, start_time: datetime) -> datetime:
    end_raw = component.get("DTEND")
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("DTEND")) if end_raw else start_time


def _component_recurrence_id(component: Any) -> datetime | None:
    if not component.get("RECURRENCE-ID"):
        return None
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("RECURRENCE-ID"))


def _excluded_occurrence_keys(component: Any) -> set[str]:
    exdate_values = component.get("EXDATE")
    if not exdate_values:
        return set()
    if not isinstance(exdate_values, list):
        exdate_values = [exdate_values]

    excluded = set()
    for exdate_value in exdate_values:
        for item in getattr(exdate_value, "dts", []):
            excluded.add(_occurrence_key(_to_datetime(item.dt)))
    return excluded


def _tombstone_stale_occurrences(
    connected_calendar: Any, href: str, seen_provider_ids: set[str]
) -> int:
    from calendars.models import ExternalEventMirror

    return _tombstone_mirrors(
        ExternalEventMirror.objects.filter(
            connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
            provider_event_id__startswith=f"{href}#",
            status="ACTIVE",
        ).exclude(provider_event_id__in=seen_provider_ids)
    )


def _tombstone_mirrors(mirrors_qs: Any) -> int:
    from events.models import Event

    event_ids = list(
        mirrors_qs.exclude(local_event__isnull=True).values_list(
            "local_event_id", flat=True
        )
    )
    now = timezone.now()
    updated_count: int = mirrors_qs.update(
        status="TOMBSTONED",
        tombstoned_at=now,
        local_event=None,
        updated_at=now,
    )
    if event_ids:
        Event.objects.filter(pk__in=event_ids, is_external=True).delete()
    return updated_count


def _to_datetime(value: datetime | date) -> datetime:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        parsed = value
    else:
        parsed = datetime.combine(value, time.min)
    if timezone.is_naive(parsed):
        return timezone.make_aware(parsed, datetime_timezone.utc)
    return parsed


def _recurrence_expansion_window() -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
    now = timezone.now()
    return (
        now - timedelta(days=RECURRENCE_EXPANSION_PAST_DAYS),
        now + timedelta(days=RECURRENCE_EXPANSION_FUTURE_DAYS),
    )


def _caldav_timestamp(value: datetime) -> str:
    return value.astimezone(datetime_timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


def _occurrence_key(value: datetime) -> str:
    return _caldav_timestamp(value)


def _event_to_ical(event: Any) -> str:
    calendar = ICalendar()
    calendar.add("prodid", "-//ClanCal//Calendar Sync//EN")
    calendar.add("version", "2.0")
    item = ICalendarEvent()
    item.add("uid", str(event.id))
    item.add("summary", event.title)
    item.add("description", event.description or "")
    item.add("location", event.location or "")
    item.add("dtstart", event.start_time)
    item.add("dtend", event.end_time)
    item.add(
        "status", "TENTATIVE" if event.event_status == "TENTATIVE" else "CONFIRMED"
    )
    calendar.add_component(item)
    return calendar.to_ical().decode()

    profile = getattr(user, "profile", None)

    membership = user.family_memberships.first()

    totals = {"events_added": 0, "events_updated": 0, "events_deleted": 0}

    for connected_calendar in connection.calendars.filter(is_selected=True):
        calendar_result = _sync_apple_calendar(
            session,
            connected_calendar,
            full_sync=full_sync,
        )
        for key, value in calendar_result.items():
            totals[key] += value

    connection.status = "ACTIVE"
    connection.last_success_at = timezone.now()
    connection.last_error_code = ""
    connection.last_error_message = ""
    connection.save(
        update_fields=[
            "status",
            "last_success_at",
            "last_error_code",
            "last_error_message",
            "updated_at",
        ]
    )

def export_event_to_apple_caldav(event: Event, connected_calendar: ConnectedCalendar) -> dict[str, str]:
    from calendars.models import ExternalEventMirror

    if not connected_calendar.supports_write:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Selected Apple calendar is read-only.")
    if connected_calendar.connection.provider != "APPLE_ICLOUD":
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Calendar is not an Apple iCloud calendar.")

    session = _authenticated_session(connected_calendar.connection)
    mirror = ExternalEventMirror.objects.filter(
        connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
        local_event=event,
    ).first()
    href = (
        mirror.provider_event_id
        if mirror is not None
        else urljoin(connected_calendar.provider_calendar_id, f"{event.id}.ics")
    )
    ical_body = _event_to_ical(event)
    response = session.request(
        "PUT",
        href,
        data=ical_body,
        headers={"Content-Type": "text/calendar; charset=utf-8"},
        timeout=20,
    )
    if response.status_code not in {200, 201, 204}:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar rejected the event export.")

    ExternalEventMirror.objects.update_or_create(
        connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
        local_event=event,
        defaults={
            "provider_event_id": href,
            "i_cal_uid": str(event.id),
            "provider_etag": response.headers.get("ETag", ""),
            "status": "ACTIVE",
            "presentation_mode": "FULL_DETAILS",
            "share_policy_locked": False,
            "starts_at": event.start_time,
            "ends_at": event.end_time,
            "raw_payload": {"direction": "export"},
            "last_seen_at": timezone.now(),
        },
    )
    return {"href": href, "etag": response.headers.get("ETag", "")}


def _authenticated_session(connection: CalendarConnection) -> requests.Session:
    session = requests.Session()
    session.auth = (connection.account_email, connection.app_specific_password)
    return session


def _sync_apple_calendar(
    session: requests.Session, connected_calendar: ConnectedCalendar, *, full_sync: bool
) -> dict[str, int]:
    if connected_calendar.sync_token and not full_sync:
        response = _sync_collection(session, connected_calendar)
        if response.status_code == 409:
            connected_calendar.sync_token = ""
            connected_calendar.save(update_fields=["sync_token", "updated_at"])
            response = _calendar_query(session, connected_calendar)
    else:
        response = _calendar_query(session, connected_calendar)

    if response.status_code in {401, 403}:
        connection = connected_calendar.connection
        connection.status = "REAUTH_REQUIRED"
        connection.last_error_code = "APPLE_REAUTH_REQUIRED"
        connection.last_error_message = "Apple Calendar credentials were rejected."
        connection.save(
            update_fields=[
                "status",
                "last_error_code",
                "last_error_message",
                "updated_at",
            ]
        )
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar credentials were rejected.")
    if response.status_code >= 400:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar sync failed.")

    return _apply_multistatus(connected_calendar, response.text)


def _sync_collection(session: requests.Session, connected_calendar: ConnectedCalendar) -> requests.Response:
    expansion_start, expansion_end = _recurrence_expansion_window()
    return session.request(
        "REPORT",
        connected_calendar.provider_calendar_id,
        headers={"Depth": "1"},
        data=f"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<d:sync-collection xmlns:d="{DAV_NS}">
  <d:sync-token>{connected_calendar.sync_token}</d:sync-token>
  <d:sync-level>1</d:sync-level>
  <d:prop>
    <d:getetag />
    <cal:calendar-data xmlns:cal="{CALDAV_NS}">
      <cal:expand start="{_caldav_timestamp(expansion_start)}" end="{_caldav_timestamp(expansion_end)}" />
    </cal:calendar-data>
  </d:prop>
</d:sync-collection>""",
        timeout=30,
    )


def _calendar_query(session: requests.Session, connected_calendar: ConnectedCalendar) -> requests.Response:
    expansion_start, expansion_end = _recurrence_expansion_window()
    return session.request(
        "REPORT",
        connected_calendar.provider_calendar_id,
        headers={"Depth": "1"},
        data=f"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<cal:calendar-query xmlns:d="{DAV_NS}" xmlns:cal="{CALDAV_NS}">

def _apply_multistatus(
    connected_calendar: ConnectedCalendar, document: str
) -> dict[str, int]:
    from calendars.models import IMPORTED_EXTERNAL_EVENT_VISIBILITY, ExternalEventMirror
    from events.models import Event

    result = {"events_added": 0, "events_updated": 0, "events_deleted": 0}
    root = fromstring(document)
    sync_token = _xml_child_text(root, ".//{DAV:}sync-token")

    for dav_response in root.findall(".//{DAV:}response"):
        href = _absolute_icloud_url(_xml_child_text(dav_response, "{DAV:}href"))
        status_text = " ".join(
            node.text or "" for node in dav_response.findall(".//{DAV:}status")
        )
        if "404" in status_text or "410" in status_text:
            result["events_deleted"] += _tombstone_mirrors(
                ExternalEventMirror.objects.filter(
                    connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
                ).filter(
                    models.Q(provider_event_id=href)
                    | models.Q(provider_event_id__startswith=f"{href}#")
                )
            )
            continue

        calendar_data = _xml_child_text(
            dav_response, ".//{urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-data"
        )
        if not calendar_data:
            continue
        event_payloads = _parse_event_instances(calendar_data)
        if not event_payloads:
            continue

        mode = connected_calendar.import_mode
        if mode == "HIDDEN":
            continue

        seen_provider_ids = set()
        for event_payload in event_payloads:
            provider_event_id = f"{href}{event_payload['provider_occurrence_suffix']}"
            seen_provider_ids.add(provider_event_id)
            title = event_payload["title"] if mode == "FULL_DETAILS" else "Busy"
            location = event_payload["location"] if mode == "FULL_DETAILS" else ""
            description = event_payload["description"] if mode == "FULL_DETAILS" else ""
            visibility = (
                "PRIVATE"
                if mode == "FULL_DETAILS"
                else IMPORTED_EXTERNAL_EVENT_VISIBILITY
            )

            with transaction.atomic():
                event, created = Event.objects.update_or_create(
                    is_external=True,
                    external_source="APPLE_ICLOUD",
                    external_id=provider_event_id,
                    calendar_id=str(connected_calendar.id),
                    defaults={
                        "title": title,
                        "description": description,
                        "location": location,
                        "start_time": event_payload["start_time"],
                        "end_time": event_payload["end_time"],
                        "creator": connected_calendar.connection.user,
                        "family_group": _primary_family_for_user(
                            connected_calendar.connection.user
                        ),
                        "visibility": visibility,
                        "event_status": event_payload["event_status"],
                    },
                )
                ExternalEventMirror.objects.update_or_create(
                    connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
                    provider_event_id=provider_event_id,
                    defaults={
                        "local_event": event,
                        "i_cal_uid": event_payload["uid"],
                        "provider_etag": _xml_child_text(
                            dav_response, ".//{DAV:}getetag"
                        ),
                        "status": "ACTIVE",
                        "source_visibility_raw": event_payload["classification"],
                        "source_class_raw": event_payload["classification"],
                        "presentation_mode": mode,
                        "share_policy_locked": mode != "FULL_DETAILS",
                        "starts_at": event.start_time,
                        "ends_at": event.end_time,
                        "raw_payload": event_payload["raw_payload"],
                        "last_seen_at": timezone.now(),
                    },
                )
            result["events_added" if created else "events_updated"] += 1
        result["events_deleted"] += _tombstone_stale_occurrences(
            connected_calendar,
            href,
            seen_provider_ids,
        )

    if sync_token:
        connected_calendar.sync_token = sync_token
        connected_calendar.last_incremental_sync_at = timezone.now()
        connected_calendar.save(
            update_fields=[
                "sync_token",
                "last_incremental_sync_at",
                "updated_at",
            ]
        )
    return result


def _parse_event_instances(calendar_data: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    calendar = ICalendar.from_ical(calendar_data)
    components = list(calendar.walk("VEVENT"))
    overrides: dict[tuple[str, str], Any] = {}
    for component in components:
        recurrence_id = _component_recurrence_id(component)
        if recurrence_id is None:
            continue
        overrides[(str(component.get("UID") or ""), _occurrence_key(recurrence_id))] = (
            component
        )
    master_uids = {
        str(component.get("UID") or "")
        for component in components
        if component.get("RRULE") and not component.get("RECURRENCE-ID")
    }
    payloads: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for component in components:
        recurrence_id = _component_recurrence_id(component)
        if recurrence_id is not None:
            if str(component.get("UID") or "") not in master_uids:
                payloads.append(
                    _event_payload(
                        component,
                        recurrence_key=_occurrence_key(recurrence_id),
                    )
                )
            continue

        if component.get("RRULE"):
            payloads.extend(_expand_recurring_component(component, overrides))
        else:
            payloads.append(_event_payload(component, recurrence_key=""))

    return payloads


def _expand_recurring_component(
    component: Component, overrides: dict[tuple[str, str], Component]
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    window_start, window_end = _recurrence_expansion_window()
    start_time = _component_start(component)
    end_time = _component_end(component, start_time)
    duration = end_time - start_time
    rule_text = component.get("RRULE").to_ical().decode()
    rule = rrulestr(rule_text, dtstart=start_time)
    excluded_occurrences = _excluded_occurrence_keys(component)
    uid = str(component.get("UID") or "")
    payloads = []

    for occurrence_start in rule.between(window_start, window_end, inc=True):
        recurrence_key = _occurrence_key(occurrence_start)
        if recurrence_key in excluded_occurrences:
            continue
        override = overrides.get((uid, recurrence_key))
        if override is not None:
            payloads.append(_event_payload(override, recurrence_key=recurrence_key))
        else:
            payloads.append(
                _event_payload(
                    component,
                    start_time=occurrence_start,
                    end_time=occurrence_start + duration,
                    recurrence_key=recurrence_key,
                )
            )

    return payloads


def _event_payload(
    component: Any,
    *,
    start_time: datetime | None = None,
    end_time: datetime | None = None,
    recurrence_key: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    start_time = start_time or _component_start(component)
    end_time = end_time or _component_end(component, start_time)
    status = str(component.get("STATUS", "CONFIRMED")).upper()
    return {
        "uid": str(component.get("UID") or uuid4()),
        "title": str(component.get("SUMMARY") or "Busy"),
        "description": str(component.get("DESCRIPTION") or ""),
        "location": str(component.get("LOCATION") or ""),
        "start_time": start_time,
        "end_time": end_time,
        "event_status": "TENTATIVE" if status == "TENTATIVE" else "CONFIRMED",
        "classification": str(component.get("CLASS") or ""),
        "provider_occurrence_suffix": f"#{recurrence_key}" if recurrence_key else "",
        "raw_payload": {
            "summary": str(component.get("SUMMARY") or ""),
            "description": str(component.get("DESCRIPTION") or ""),
            "location": str(component.get("LOCATION") or ""),
            "status": status,
            "recurrence_id": recurrence_key,
        },
    }


def _component_start(component: Any) -> datetime:
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("DTSTART"))


def _component_end(component: Any, start_time: datetime) -> datetime:
    end_raw = component.get("DTEND")
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("DTEND")) if end_raw else start_time


def _component_recurrence_id(component: Any) -> datetime | None:
    if not component.get("RECURRENCE-ID"):
        return None
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("RECURRENCE-ID"))


def _excluded_occurrence_keys(component: Any) -> set[str]:
    exdate_values = component.get("EXDATE")
    if not exdate_values:
        return set()
    if not isinstance(exdate_values, list):
        exdate_values = [exdate_values]

    excluded = set()
    for exdate_value in exdate_values:
        for item in getattr(exdate_value, "dts", []):
            excluded.add(_occurrence_key(_to_datetime(item.dt)))
    return excluded


def _tombstone_stale_occurrences(
    connected_calendar: Any, href: str, seen_provider_ids: set[str]
) -> int:
    from calendars.models import ExternalEventMirror

    return _tombstone_mirrors(
        ExternalEventMirror.objects.filter(
            connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
            provider_event_id__startswith=f"{href}#",
            status="ACTIVE",
        ).exclude(provider_event_id__in=seen_provider_ids)
    )


def _tombstone_mirrors(mirrors_qs: Any) -> int:
    from events.models import Event

    event_ids = list(
        mirrors_qs.exclude(local_event__isnull=True).values_list(
            "local_event_id", flat=True
        )
    )
    now = timezone.now()
    updated_count: int = mirrors_qs.update(
        status="TOMBSTONED",
        tombstoned_at=now,
        local_event=None,
        updated_at=now,
    )
    if event_ids:
        Event.objects.filter(pk__in=event_ids, is_external=True).delete()

def _to_datetime(value: datetime | date) -> datetime:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        parsed = value
    else:
        parsed = datetime.combine(value, time.min)
    if timezone.is_naive(parsed):
        return timezone.make_aware(parsed, datetime_timezone.utc)
    return parsed


def _recurrence_expansion_window() -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
    now = timezone.now()
    return (
        now - timedelta(days=RECURRENCE_EXPANSION_PAST_DAYS),
        now + timedelta(days=RECURRENCE_EXPANSION_FUTURE_DAYS),

def _caldav_timestamp(value: datetime) -> str:

def _event_to_ical(event: Any) -> str:
    calendar = ICalendar()
    calendar.add("prodid", "-//ClanCal//Calendar Sync//EN")
    calendar.add("version", "2.0")
    item = ICalendarEvent()
    item.add("uid", str(event.id))
    item.add("summary", event.title)
    item.add("description", event.description or "")
    item.add("location", event.location or "")
    item.add("dtstart", event.start_time)
    item.add("dtend", event.end_time)
    item.add(
        "status", "TENTATIVE" if event.event_status == "TENTATIVE" else "CONFIRMED"
    )
    calendar.add_component(item)
    return calendar.to_ical().decode()

def sync_apple_caldav_connection(
    connection_id: str, *, full_sync: bool = False
) -> dict[str, int]:

    connection = CalendarConnection.objects.select_related("user").get(

def export_event_to_apple_caldav(event: Event, connected_calendar: ConnectedCalendar) -> dict[str, str]:
    from calendars.models import ExternalEventMirror

    if not connected_calendar.supports_write:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Selected Apple calendar is read-only.")
    if connected_calendar.connection.provider != "APPLE_ICLOUD":
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Calendar is not an Apple iCloud calendar.")

    session = _authenticated_session(connected_calendar.connection)
    mirror = ExternalEventMirror.objects.filter(
        connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
        local_event=event,
    ).first()
    href = (
        mirror.provider_event_id
        if mirror is not None
        else urljoin(connected_calendar.provider_calendar_id, f"{event.id}.ics")
    )
    ical_body = _event_to_ical(event)
    response = session.request(
        "PUT",
        href,
        data=ical_body,
        headers={"Content-Type": "text/calendar; charset=utf-8"},
        timeout=20,
    )
    if response.status_code not in {200, 201, 204}:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar rejected the event export.")

    ExternalEventMirror.objects.update_or_create(
        connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
        local_event=event,
        defaults={
            "provider_event_id": href,
            "i_cal_uid": str(event.id),
            "provider_etag": response.headers.get("ETag", ""),
            "status": "ACTIVE",
            "presentation_mode": "FULL_DETAILS",
            "share_policy_locked": False,
            "starts_at": event.start_time,
            "ends_at": event.end_time,
            "raw_payload": {"direction": "export"},
            "last_seen_at": timezone.now(),
        },
    )
    return {"href": href, "etag": response.headers.get("ETag", "")}

def _sync_apple_calendar(
    session: requests.Session, connected_calendar: ConnectedCalendar, *, full_sync: bool
) -> dict[str, int]:
    if connected_calendar.sync_token and not full_sync:
        response = _sync_collection(session, connected_calendar)
        if response.status_code == 409:
            connected_calendar.sync_token = ""
            connected_calendar.save(update_fields=["sync_token", "updated_at"])
            response = _calendar_query(session, connected_calendar)
    else:
        response = _calendar_query(session, connected_calendar)

    if response.status_code in {401, 403}:
        connection = connected_calendar.connection
        connection.status = "REAUTH_REQUIRED"
        connection.last_error_code = "APPLE_REAUTH_REQUIRED"
        connection.last_error_message = "Apple Calendar credentials were rejected."
        connection.save(
            update_fields=[
                "status",
                "last_error_code",
                "last_error_message",
                "updated_at",
            ]
        )
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar credentials were rejected.")
    if response.status_code >= 400:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar sync failed.")

    return _apply_multistatus(connected_calendar, response.text)
